ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Intro to Design for Non-Majors. Theory and practice in the elements, processes and principles of design. Course content is organized under three headings: COLOR, a study of the visual, material and psychological nature of color; COMMUNICATION, an introduction to the fundamentals of visual communication using primarily digital media; and 3D CRAFT, a survey of fabrication techniques using three-dimensional media. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, may be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term. Open to campus, no restrictions.
